description: Hypothesis: 32-row staged FP8 expert matrices, fused FP32 gate/up/SiLU with direct FP16 activation output, and cooperative route grouping improve the online-attention base prefill result (1596.1 tok/s), while preserving conformance, retrieval and cache behavior. The preceding local profile ranked expert matrices at 37.9%/33.1% of sampled encoder interval sums at 10K/30K; those shares are not exclusive wall time. Keep the same FP8 target, DFlash2 draft, FP16 KV, FP32 accumulation/state, prefix caching, 2048-token chunks and explicit 32K context. Run all seven tests with the full profile and inherit the existing thresholds. Several kernels change together; use separate local ablations for attribution. Software prefetch and K=64/128 were rejected in development. The latest evaluator revision has the same definition and script hashes as the base.
